chapters.title: Stillwater
summary: Mr. Popper is a house painter in Stillwater.
He is a dreamer and loves far-away lands.
He wants to see the North and South Poles.
The painting season ends in late September.

chapters.title: The Voice in the Air
summary: Mr. Popper reads a book about the South Pole.
He thinks penguins are the funniest birds.
He listens to Admiral Drake on the radio.
The Admiral promises Mr. Popper a surprise.

chapters.title: Out of the Antarctic
summary: Mr. Popper waits for his surprise from the Admiral.
A very large box arrives at the house.
The box has air holes and says keep cool.
Inside the box is a real penguin.
Mr. Popper is very happy with his new pet.

chapters.title: Captain Cook
summary: The penguin inspects the house with a little strut.
Mr. Popper fills the bathtub with cold water.
The penguin jumps into the tub and slides around.
They name the penguin Captain Cook.
Captain Cook eats the goldfish in the dining room.
Captain Cook sleeps in the refrigerator at night.

chapters.title: Troubles with a Penguin
summary: Mr. Popper wants holes in the refrigerator door.
The service man thinks Mr. Popper is crazy.
The service man drills five holes for air.
Captain Cook pecks the service man on the floor.
The service man runs away very quickly.

chapters.title: More Troubles
summary: A policeman comes to the back door.
The children explain they have a pet penguin.
Mr. Popper calls City Hall for a license.
The person on the phone is very confused.
Mr. Popper decides to do without a license.

chapters.title: Captain Cook Builds a Nest
summary: Captain Cook explores every room in the house.
He collects many small items from the house.
He puts checkers and marbles in the icebox.
Mr. Popper says this is a penguin rookery.
Mr. Popper dresses up like a penguin in a tailcoat.

chapters.title: Penguin’s Promenade
summary: Mr. Popper takes Captain Cook for a walk.
The penguin is on a clothesline leash.
Neighbors are very surprised to see the bird.
A reporter and a photographer take their picture.
The picture appears in the newspapers later.

chapters.title: In the Barber Shop
summary: They go into a quiet barber shop.
Captain Cook jumps on a ledge to watch.
A man gets scared and runs away.
They climb up three flights of stairs.
They toboggan down the stairs on their stomachs.

chapters.title: Shadows
summary: Captain Cook becomes very famous in the news.
The penguin stops exploring and becomes very quiet.
He is very sick with a high temperature.
The doctor says the climate is too warm.
Mr. Popper writes a letter for help.

chapters.title: Greta
summary: The Curator sends a female penguin named Greta.
Captain Cook is very happy and gets well.
There are now two penguins in the refrigerator.
Mr. Popper paints names on their black backs.

chapters.title: More Mouths to Feed
summary: The family wears overcoats inside the cold house.
Mr. Popper freezes the floors to make ice.
Greta lays ten eggs over several days.
There are now twelve penguins in the family.
Mr. Popper builds an ice castle in the cellar.

chapters.title: Money Worries
summary: Mr. Popper installs a freezing plant in the cellar.
The family has no more money for fish.
Mr. Popper decides to train the penguins.
The penguins learn to march and perform tricks.
Mrs. Popper plays the piano for the act.

chapters.title: Mr. Greenbaum
summary: The family takes the penguins to the Palace Theater.
The twelve penguins travel on a city bus.
Mr. Greenbaum is a famous theater owner.
He watches the penguins and likes the act.
He wants to see them perform on stage.

chapters.title: Popper’s Performing Penguins
summary: The penguins rehearse on a real stage.
They march to a Military March song.
Two penguins have a mock fight on stage.
The penguins climb ladders and toboggan down.
Mr. Greenbaum offers them a big contract.

chapters.title: On the Road
summary: The family travels to many different cities.
They take taxis to the railway station.
Mr. Popper rides with the penguins in a car.
The penguins cause trouble in the sleeping cars.
They perform their show in a new theater.

chapters.title: Fame
summary: The penguins become extremely famous everywhere.
Huge crowds wait in line for theater tickets.
The penguins hide under a singer's blue skirts.
The family gets five thousand dollars every week.
A company gives them free cans of shrimp.

chapters.title: April Winds
summary: The weather becomes very hot in New York.
The penguins are irritable because of the heat.
Mr. Popper takes them to a roof garden.
He makes a mistake and goes to the Regal.

chapters.title: Admiral Drake
summary: The penguins meet seals at the wrong theater.
There is a lot of confusion on the stage.
Mr. Popper is arrested and goes to jail.
Admiral Drake comes to help Mr. Popper.
The Admiral wants to take penguins to North Pole.

chapters.title: Farewell, Mr. Popper
summary: Mr. Popper decides to let the penguins go.
He thinks the cold climate is better for them.
Admiral Drake asks Mr. Popper to go along.
Mr. Popper leaves for the North Pole.
The family stays home with plenty of money.
